title: Ninety Seconds in the Parking Lot
停車場上的九十秒
paras: Marco Silva had been dreading this Thursday for weeks. The state {{inspector|inspector}}, Ms. Lang, was coming to the bicycle plant for the annual safety {{inspection|inspection}}, and he had scheduled a fire {{drill|drill}} for the same morning, hoping to show her how well his team could respond.
馬可．席爾瓦已經緊張好幾個星期了，就為了這個星期四。州政府的檢查員朗女士要來這間腳踏車工廠做年度安全檢查，而他把消防演習也排在同一個早上，希望讓她看看自己的團隊反應有多好。

She started on the {{assembly|assembly}} line, where workers fitted wheels onto frames, and moved on to the heavy {{machinery|machinery}} in back. While she was {{inspect|inspecting}} a metal press, she stopped. "This guard doesn't {{conform|conform}} to the new standard. It's four inches too short." Marco winced. Near the door she pointed at a power cord lying across the walkway. "That's a trip {{hazard|hazard}}, and somebody will fall." Then she noticed a temp worker under the crane with no {{helmet|helmet}}.
她先從組裝線看起，工人正把輪子裝上車架，接著她轉往後方的重型機械。檢查一台金屬壓床時，她停了下來。「這個護罩不符合新標準，短了四英寸。」馬可皺了一下眉。靠近門口時，她指著橫過走道的電線說：「這是絆倒人的隱患，遲早有人會摔倒。」接著她又注意到起重機下面有個臨時工沒戴安全帽。
Before Marco could answer, the alarm rang. Ninety workers walked out and stood in the parking lot, and Ms. Lang timed them. Ninety seconds. "Not bad," she said, and almost smiled.
馬可還來不及回答，警報就響了。九十名工人走出廠房，在停車場站好，朗女士在一旁計時。九十秒。「還不錯。」她說，嘴角幾乎帶著笑意。

Back inside, she gave him the list. "The plant must {{comply|comply}} with the new rules by the end of the month. Fix the guard, tape down that cord, and enforce helmets. Do that, and I'll {{certify|certify}} the plant for another year." Marco spent the weekend on the repairs. The certificate arrived the following Wednesday.
回到室內，她把清單交給他。「這間工廠必須在月底前遵守新規定。把護罩修好、把那條電線貼牢，並且確實要求戴安全帽。做到這些，我就會再認證工廠一年。」馬可整個週末都在處理修繕。證書在下個星期三寄到了。
